caveat: The Jamuna (Brahmaputra) is not a recognised Mars analog. It is shown beside Jezero at the same scale only to compare shapes: a living braided river against an ancient delta. Recognised analogs for Jezero's delta include the Wax Lake Delta (Louisiana).
